company_profile: KONUX builds AI and IIoT solutions that help railway operators monitor infrastructure and plan maintenance from sensor data.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years building and testing statistical and ML models for production systems across Telecom, AIOps and Healthcare. Works with time-series KPIs from telecom network devices, alarm streams and event logs for anomaly detection, forecasting and event correlation, owning problems from the customer's challenge to a deployed, monitored model. Fluent in Python, Pandas, PySpark and SQL, with Git, CI/CD, MLflow, Docker and Databricks. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Shipped anomaly detection and demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs
experience_edits.new: Built and tested anomaly detection and demand forecasting models on 15+ time-series KPIs from 500+ telecom network devices with Isolation Forest and Holt-Winters, enabling earlier detection and proactive planning.

experience_edits.original: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction system
experience_edits.new: Deployed an SLA breach prediction model into a live production system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, using GPT-3.5 for real-time root-cause analysis and remediation per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.

experience_edits.original: Built an event-correlation engine clustering alarms with Sentence-BERT
experience_edits.new: Built an event-correlation engine clustering network alarm events with Sentence-BERT and DBSCAN, tracing the cascading effect of alarm floods to the root event and improving semantic alarm classification by 73.5%.

experience_edits.original: Delivered technical POCs and consulting for 15+ clients
experience_edits.new: Translated client challenges into technical POCs and consulting for 15+ clients across 3+ AIOps and ML platforms, contributing to an 11% increase in POC and mentoring revenue.

project.name: Vibration Sensor Anomaly Detection
bullets: Built an anomaly detection and failure-risk model for industrial vibration sensor data, extracting rolling statistical and frequency features with Pandas and scoring them with Isolation Forest and LightGBM.
Evaluated detections against labelled maintenance events with backtesting, packaged the pipeline with unit tests and CI/CD on Databricks, and tracked and monitored models in MLflow.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role. My data science work has mostly been on time-series signals from live systems, such as network KPIs, alarm streams and logs, where I built models, tested them and released them into production myself. The thread through it is taking a messy real-world problem all the way to a model people trust.

KONUX applies AI to sensor data from railway infrastructure, so a good model means better maintenance decisions and fewer surprises on the track, which is work I find worth doing. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Munich together and settle there long term.

I would bring production experience on this kind of data. At Viavi I shipped anomaly detection and demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs across 500+ network devices, and deployed an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to test carefully and listen to the people using what I build. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to your team.
